Name: Nyapu Aurelian Portraits
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
I edited and color altered some portraits provided by Nyapu and Aelinore-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPC included in the "Aurelian - Custom NPC" mod by Rupnan!

^^Apologies if there's any misalignment as I did not test the portraits in my own game. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to Nyapu and Aelinore for the assets! Credits to Rupnan for the NPC mod!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b]
[/size]Unzip the download file "AurelianNPC" and then drag the "[NPC] Aurelian" folder into your already existing folder for the main mod. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.
OR you can find the "npc" folder at --[i][NPC] Aurelian\assets\images\npc[/i]-- yourself and drag the replacers into it. Personally, I tend to do this just to ensure everything goes neatly where it is supposed to :P

[b]Requirements[/b]
These are REPLACERS! You need the " Aurelian - Custom NPC" mod for these to work.
